Name: Truly Rainbow Trout
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
This is just a silly little mod to make rainbow trout [i]actually[/i] rainbow. What you see is what you get! When you catch rainbow trout, they will now actually be rainbow colored, and they'll look as such even in the aquarium. Hope you enjoy this little bit of silliness!


[b]Installation: [/b]
[b]1. [/b]Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2. [/b]Unzip the '[CP] Truly Rainbow Trout' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]3. [/b]Congrats, you're done and ready to go! Enjoy your new rainbow trout!
